routes.title: Water & air
routes.description: Reflections, open water and soft skies. A route for wandering slowly.

routes.title: Quiet forms
routes.description: Rounded edges, woven surfaces and familiar objects. Stay with one small detail.

routes.title: Colour & light
routes.description: Gardens, bright shapes and changing light. A more colourful, playful route.

works.title: Boats at Rest
works.alt: A blue boat with a white cloth inside and a smaller green boat rest on a grassy riverbank, beside still water reflecting distant houses.
looking: Follow the curved edge of the blue boat.
Find a shape on the far bank and its reflection in the water.

works.title: Water Lilies
works.alt: Pink and white water lilies spread across blue-green water, with soft reflections beneath them.
looking: Choose one lily pad and follow its rounded edge.
Notice a small patch of pink among the reflections.

works.title: Nocturne: Blue and Gold—Southampton Water
works.alt: A low golden moon hangs above a hazy blue-green harbor, with faint boats and a dark shoreline.
looking: Find the small moon above the water.
Follow the long line where water meets the distant shore.

works.title: The White Bridge
works.alt: A white footbridge crosses a brook behind slender trees, surrounded by soft green foliage and reflections.
looking: Find the white railing among the green brushstrokes.
Follow one thin tree trunk from the bank towards the top.

works.title: Flower Clouds
works.alt: A small sailing boat with two figures floats beneath clouds of violet, orange, pink, and blue.
looking: Compare the small sail with the wide cloud above it.
Choose one patch of colour and follow its edge.

works.title: Moonrise
works.alt: An orange moon glows through a hazy landscape of trees and a solitary figure.
looking: Find the moon, then notice a darker shape nearby.
Look for one soft edge and one clearer edge.

works.title: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte — 1884
works.alt: People with parasols gather in a sunlit park beside the Seine, with boats in the distance.
looking: Choose a parasol and follow its curve.
Notice one figure near the front and another farther away.

works.title: Moon Jar
works.alt: A rounded white Korean porcelain moon jar with a gently uneven outline and a softly glazed surface.
looking: Follow one side of the jar from its rim towards its base.
Compare the two sides of its rounded outline.

works.title: Bowl
works.alt: A small pale mosaic-glass bowl with a rounded body, short foot, and dark striped rim, on a gray background.
looking: Follow the dark oval around the rim.
Look for a small shape repeated in the glass.

works.title: Burden Basket
works.alt: A tan woven basket widens from a narrow base to an open rim, with repeating dark-brown triangles across its sides.
looking: Choose one triangle and follow the repeating pattern around the basket.
Notice how the form widens from its base towards the rim.

works.title: The Basket of Apples
works.alt: A tilted basket spills red and green apples across a white cloth on a wooden table, beside a dark bottle and a plate of biscuits.
looking: Follow one fold of the white cloth. Where does it lead your eye?
Compare the round apples with the bottle and the table edges.

works.title: Statuette of a Female Figure
works.alt: A pale marble standing figure with folded arms, a long neck, and a simple oval face with a raised nose.
works.maker: Cycladic; probably from the island of Keros
looking: Follow the outline from one shoulder towards the feet.
Notice where the folded arms meet the body.

works.title: Thenot Under Fruit Tree
works.alt: A small black-and-white wood engraving of resting figures under trees, with a round bright light above distant hills.
looking: Find a light gap between the dark branches.
Follow one curve of a hill in the distance.

works.title: Woman in a Garden
works.alt: A seated woman in a blue dress and flowered hat, surrounded by loosely painted green foliage and pale flowers.
looking: Find the blue of the dress among the greens.
Choose one visible brushstroke and notice its direction.

works.title: Plum Garden at Kameido
works.alt: Dark plum-tree branches with white blossoms cross a pink sky, framing a green garden and small distant visitors.
looking: Follow a dark branch across the pale sky.
Compare a nearby blossom with a small figure in the distance.

works.title: Autumn Maples with Poem Slips
works.alt: A six-panel gold folding screen with red maple trees and hanging poem slips.
looking: Find three hanging poem slips among the leaves.
Follow one tree branch across the gold background.

works.title: Beach at Cabasson (Baigne-Cul)
works.alt: Three children play on a pale rocky shore beside a blue sea, with a pine branch above and many small touches of colour across the scene.
looking: Let your eyes follow the line where sky meets sea.
Find a small patch of colour repeated in the shore and water.

works.title: Movement
works.alt: Orange circles, blue and green curves, and pale zigzags interweave with dark shapes in an abstract painting shown within a thin light frame.
looking: Follow the edge of the large orange circle.
Find a curved line, then a zigzag.

works.title: The Bewitched Mill
works.alt: White water streams through a vivid scene of red millwheels, blue buildings, green foliage, and small animals.
looking: Follow one white stream of water through the picture.
Find a circle, then an angular shape nearby.
